ineligibility_reasons: The launcher has not verified the isolated CODEX_HOME and excluded project configuration.
Scoped shell commands are not enforced by this configuration.
MCP server definitions and per-tool restrictions are not enforced by this configuration.
Network route restrictions are not enforced by this configuration.
codex_home_config_toml:
sandbox_mode = "workspace-write"
approval_policy = "never"
[sandbox_workspace_write]
network_access = true
writable_roots = ["/workspace/example-task", "/workspace/example-task/.scratch"]
[tools]
web_search = true
[mcp_servers."approved"]
enabled = true
[mcp_servers."rogue"]
enabled = false
